title.narrative: Bihar Urban Development Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative: Tranche 2 aims to improve and expand the water infrastructure in the towns of Bhagalpur and Gaya in Bihar, and assist the urban local bodies (ULB) of these two towns to ensure sustainable operations and maintenance (O&M) of the water services.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Access to quality and sustainable urban water supply improved

At least 85% of households in service area provided with 24/7 water supply (2017 baseline: intermittent water supply) Progress/Status: Works ongoing. The targets are likely to be achieved. Data Source: Water supply operators' or third party validators' service quality compliance reports annually Actual value:

O&M cost recovery from user charges increased to at least 80%. (2017 baseline: 0%) Progress/Status: Works ongoing. The targets are likely to be achieved. Data Source: Water supply operators' or third party validators' service quality compliance reports annually Actual value:

By 2022, Service coverage increased to 85% of households in the project areas (2017 baseline: 31% of households) Progress/Status: Works ongoing. The targets are likely to be achieved. Data Source: Water supply operators' or third party validators' service quality compliance reports annually Actual value:
NRW reduced to at least 20% (2017 baseline: 33% to 40%) Progress/Status: Works ongoing. The targets are likely to be achieved. Data Source: ULB's annual balance sheets for water supply Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Indicator Indicator: Gaya: provision of 75,000 new house service connections with functional meters installed (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Work is under progress and 25,021 house connection have been already completed. Target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: BUIDCo's quarterly progress reports. Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Six customer service centers constructed and staffed (at least 30% female staff) (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Work is under progress at 5 CSCs and one is under finishing under the project . Target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: BUIDCo's quarterly progress reports. Actual value:

Output: Staffing and skills for water supply operations improved Indicator: At least 40 staff trained to program and operate SCADA system systems (25 in Bhagalpur and 15 in Gaya, with at least 50% women participants) (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: SCADA has not been installed. Training will be imparted after SCADA installation. The target is likely to be achieved. Data Source: Training completion certificates Actual value:

Output: Staffing and skills for water supply operations improved Indicator: At least 400 ULB staff trained on key gender mainstreaming issues and role of women in NRW reduction and household/community water supply management systems (205 for Bhagalpur and 195 for Gaya including 100% women staff in both towns) (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: O&M manual submitted by M/s SREPC has been reviewed and suggestion given but still document is not finalized. So training has not been scheduled till date but the target is likely to be achieved by the end of the project. Data Source: Training completion certificates Actual value:

Output: Staffing and skills for water supply operations improved Indicator: By 2021 For Bhagalpur and Gaya: At least 400 ULB staff trained on management and O&M of urban infrastructure including water supply systems (205 for Bhagalpur and 195 for Gaya including 100% women staff at both the towns) (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: O&M is carried out as per instructions. Data Source: Training completion certificates Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: The 200 new stand posts constructed in Gaya (2017 Baseline: 1,074) Progress/Status: The work will be carried out by GMC. Target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: The UDHD's quarterly progress reports. Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: 481.35 km new distribution and transmission pipelines installed (2017 baseline: 149.6 km) Progress/Status: Work is under Progress and 375 km of pipeline have been laid. Target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: BUIDCo's quarterly progress reports. Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: new reservoirs constructed with total storage capacity of 9,100 m3 (2017 baseline: 15 m3) Progress/Status: Work is under Progress. Target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: BUIDCo's quarterly progress reports. Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Water intake with capacity of 140 MLD completed (2017 baseline: 17 MLD) Progress/Status: Work is under Progress. Target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: BUIDCo's quarterly progress reports. Actual value:

Output: Water supply infrastructure constructed and rehabilitated Indicator: By 2021, Bhagalpur: One additional water treatment plant with a capacity of 90 MLD constructed and commissioned (2017 baseline: 17 MLD) Progress/Status: Work is under Progress. Target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: BUIDCo's quarterly progress reports
Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: 11 storage reservoirs constructed with total storage capacity 26,530 m3 (2017 baseline: 0 m3) Progress/Status: Work ongoing. Target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: BUIDCo's quarterly progress reports. Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Additional 31.25 km transmission mains constructed (2017 baseline: 6.0 km) Progress/Status: Work is under Progress. 20.8 km pipeline laid. Target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: BUIDCo's quarterly progress reports Actual value:

Output: Systems for water supply service delivery management improved Indicator: By 2021:
Water operations financial statement issued every year (2017 baseline: none) Progress/Status: Proposed under the procurement of Institutional Development and Capacity Building Consultancy which is under process. The target is likely to be achieved. Data Source: Balance sheet for water supply operations from ULB of Bhagalpur and Gaya Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2021 Target value: N

Output: Systems for water supply service delivery management improved Indicator: New accounting system developed (2017 baseline: not applicable) Progress/Status: Proposed under the procurement of Institutional Development and Capacity Building Consultancy which is under process. The target is likely to be achieved. Data Source: Water supply operators' or third party validators' service quality compliance reports annually Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2021 Target value: N

Output: Systems for water supply service delivery management improved Indicator: Water user charge plan, incorporating special concessionary arrangements for vulnerable and/or women-headed households, developed and adopted by ULB (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Tariff is fixed by Government of Bihar and accordingly concerned ULB is to implement. Data Source: Balance sheet for water supply operations from ULB of Bhagalpur and Gaya Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2021 Target value: N
